description.zh: 回源缓存数据TTL(最大值)，取值范围为30 - 86400
description.en: The maximum TTL period of the cached data retrieved from the origin DNS server. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 30 to 86400.

description.zh: 回源缓存数据TTL(最小值)，取值范围为30 - 86400
description.en: The minimum time-to-live (TTL) period of the cached data retrieved from the origin Domain Name System (DNS) server. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 30 to 86400.

description.en: The domain name. You can call the [DescribeDomains](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d\_0) operation to obtian the domain name.

description.zh:
权威代理域名实例ID。<props="china">可通过调用[ListCloudGtmInstances](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-listcloudgtminstances?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)获取</props>

description.en: The instance ID of the cache-accelerated domain name. You can call the [ListCloudGtmInstances](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-listcloudgtminstances?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d\_0) operation to obtain the ID.

description.zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，取值：
- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
默认为**zh**
description.en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English Default: **zh**

description.zh: 源站DNS服务器列表，最多支持添加10条记录
description.en: The origin DNS servers. A maximum of 10 origin DNS servers are supported.

description.zh:
源站是否支持edns。
NOT_SUPPORT：不支持，SUPPORT：支持
description.en: Specifies whether the origin DNS server supports Extension Mechanisms for DNS (EDNS). Valid values: NOT_SUPPORT and SUPPORT.
The origin protocol policy. Valid values: TCP and UDP. Default value: UDP.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns update-dns-cache-domain --lang en --domain-name example.com --instance-id dns-sg-l0000000 --cache-ttl-min 30 --cache-ttl-max 86400 --source-protocol UDP --source-edns SUPPORT --source-dns-server Port=53 Host=192.168.0.1 --region cn-hangzhou
